mainEntity.name: What should I consider before drywall installation in my kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before kitchen drywall installation, consider the layout of cabinets and appliances, as these will require precise cutouts. Ensure all electrical, plumbing, and HVAC rough-ins are complete and inspected. Plan for appropriate ventilation to manage kitchen humidity. Decide on the type of drywall; moisture-resistant is often preferred. Also, ensure the framing is sound and level, as this directly impacts the final finish quality. Clear communication with your contractor about these details is crucial.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before kitchen drywall, confirm cabinet and appliance layout, complete electrical/plumbing, ensure proper ventilation, choose moisture-resistant drywall, and verify sound framing.
